description: This file defines a PHP class `EmployeeCsvImportSampleAttachmentController` which extends an abstract file controller, responsible for generating and returning a CSV template containing employee data headers as a downloadable file.

classes.name: EmployeeCsvImportSampleAttachmentController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for serving a CSV file template with employee data headers for import purposes.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests, prepares a CSV content string with headers, sets appropriate response headers, and returns the response object.
